objective: Replace the China province debug scenario's direct GeoJSON source mutation with a test-only WorldStateV2 split and rollback commit flow.
commands: npm.cmd run lint -- src/components/map/WorldMap.tsx src/lib/test-only/china-province-debug-scenario.ts src/lib/test-only/china-province-debug-scenario.test.ts src/types/map-debug.ts e2e/game-setup.spec.ts
notes: WorldMap no longer fetches static country/border files or snapshots and replaces MapLibre sources for the China debug scenario. It dynamically loads a test-only v2 scenario helper only outside production.

The helper prepares 31 fixture Territories in a committed v2 state, runs the actual country.split planner and atomic commit, then restores the original v2 snapshot with a new committed revision. The fixture-preparation and rollback transitions are test-only state migrations, not production map commands.

The first browser run exposed a MapLibre loaded() gate that skipped committed projections while sources were updating. The gate now applies only before initial source readiness; the rerun passed split and rollback revision checks.
The focused Playwright test printed 'ok 1'. As in 11-10, its runner hung during web-server teardown and was manually interrupted after the test passed.
